streamflix-reborn.description:
Streamflix Reborn is an independent continuation of the original Streamflix project created by Lory-Stan TANASI. This reborn version maintains the same educational purpose and functionality while ensuring continued development and support.

It is an open-source Android TV and mobile app that provides a user interface for accessing publicly available streaming content from various third-party providers.

The interface aggregates content from multiple sources and provides a convenient way to browse available streaming options.

    • Open-source and ad-free interface
    • Aggregates content from multiple       third-party providers
    • No account required for the app interface
    • Educational and personal use only
    • Optimized UI & UX
    • Multiple providers
    • Resume from last playback position
    • In-app update
